notes: Grey is a PC in the party, played by Ash's player; it fights on the party's side. It takes no share of XP and gains no levels: it grows with its master's.
It knows 1 bonus tricks (Handle Animal) its master chooses, besides any taught.

+2 on Fortitude and Will saves while raging (the effect's save stays 0); +2 on melee attack rolls, +2 damage in melee and thrown (+3 two-handed), by the swing. Rage lasts 7 rounds: when it ends, or Krug stops early, call use_feature(rage, amount=-1), which takes the 2 hp off again; a rest ends it too. It leaves Krug fatigued when it ends.
While raging: no Charisma-, Dexterity- or Intelligence-based skills but Balance, Escape Artist, Intimidate and Ride; no Concentration, no spells, no items that need concentration.

Aldra's next swing (resolve_attack) smites: +2 to hit and +2 damage if the target is evil, on a melee attack: a ranged or touch attack leaves it waiting. On a melee attack at a target that isn't evil it does nothing, and is spent all the same.

Inspire Courage +1 to hit and damage; +1 on saves against charm and fear, which you add as the save's modifier. Both are morale bonuses: on a save they don't stack with another morale bonus, such as a rage's +2 on Will (only the larger counts). It lasts while the bard performs and 5 rounds after: when the song stops, remove_effect 'Inspire Courage +1' from each 5 rounds later.
Dying: each round 10% to become stable, else loses 1 HP; dead at -10.
cleave: an extra attack is due; name an adjacent foe in targets

end_of_round: Watch bleeds 1 HP (hp now -2; d% 42, not stable)

morale_due.message: Morale check due: 1/2 of side 'enemy' down. Call morale_check(rating) using the group's morale rating (monster_lookup → 'morale').

notes: On an undead lay on hands deals the damage instead (a touch attack, no attack of opportunity): rule it with apply_damage.
